event:
I withdrew the finding. The digest_size description in `hw/ip/hmac/data/hmac.hjson` (lines 269–270 and 294–295) answers the question. Only the one-hot codes for SHA2_256 (1), SHA2_384 (2) and SHA2_512 (4) are valid. Every other value, including all-zero and reserved or non-one-hot codes, is mapped to SHA2_None. Starting with SHA2_None is blocked and an error is signalled to software.

I did not check how that error maps to SwInvalidConfig in the RTL, or whether SHA-2-only mode and HMAC mode differ. The verdict was accepted.
